name: calendar-meeting-soon
prompt: A Google Calendar event starts in 15 minutes. Event: '{event.summary}'. Attendees: {event.attendees}. Description: {event.description}. If it's an internal/blocked-time event, respond [SILENT]. Otherwise: identify the external attendee(s), pull prior interaction history from Notion 'Pipeline' or 'Customers', and DM the founder a 5-line prep brief: who, what they want, last touchpoint, prep done (if any prior demo-prep brief exists), recommended opener. If this is a demo and demo-prep was not run 24h ago, do an emergency abbreviated demo-prep now.
